body:
补一条测量,供排期时估算爆炸半径。

`#3219` 修的那种**整模块** `vi.mock('@object-ui/react', …)` 写法,在本仓共有 **30 个测试文件**(含刚修好的 `plugin-calendar/src/registration.test.tsx`):

```
$ grep -rln "vi.mock('@object-ui/react'" packages/ --include=*.test.tsx --include=*.test.ts | wc -l
30
```

分布(部分):`plugin-kanban`、`plugin-detail` ×7、`plugin-view` ×3、`plugin-gantt`、`app-shell` ×多个、`plugin-calendar`。

**这不等于 29 个文件现在都是红的** —— 是否炸取决于三件事同时成立:该文件所在配置路径、有没有 setupFiles 预热了消费者模块、以及它的传递依赖恰好用到了 mock 里没列的导出。`plugin-calendar` 只是第一个三者凑齐的。但每新增一个 `@object-ui/react` 导出、或某个包的 setup 名单一变,都可能把其中任意一个翻红,**且翻红方式仍然是"一条路径红、另一条绿"**。

对本 issue 的两点含义:

1. 选项 A/B(统一或强制继承根配置)的收益比看起来大 —— 它让这 30 个文件至少**在两条路径下结论一致**,红要一起红;
2. 但**配置统一并不能单独解决整模块 mock 的脆弱性**:即使只剩一套配置,整模块 mock 仍会在下一个新增导出时失效,只是不再"一路红一路绿"而已。真正的根治要两步:配置统一 + 把这 30 处改成 `importOriginal` 部分 mock(或加一条 lint 规则禁止对 workspace 包做整模块 mock)。

`#3219` 用的断言写法可以直接复用为模板(比较导出集合、不点名具体导出):

```ts
const actual = await vi.importActual< typeof ObjectUIReact >('@object-ui/react');
const missing = Object.keys(actual).filter((name) => !(name in ObjectUIReact)).sort();
expect(missing).toEqual([]);
```

不过 30 处逐个加断言是选项 C 的成本形态(线性、且只在踩中后才发现);更划算的大概率是一条 lint 规则。**未认领,仍待维护者定方向。**

转决策收件箱:`needs-user-decision`(objectui 分片 PM,会话 `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`)。

**要拍板的一句话**:17 个包的本地 `vitest.config.ts` 是全删统一走根配置(方案 A),还是保留但强制继承根配置(方案 B)?

两轴分析:

- **项目长远合理性**:A 最彻底——一套配置一个结论,dist/源码解析分叉与 setupFiles 预热差异一次性消失;代价是 `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` 语义要重定义、turbo `test` 的 `^build` 依赖要重估。B 保住既有入口但分叉面只是收窄,需要机械检查防漂移——多一个需要长期维护的守卫。
- **防 AI 犯错**:两案都远好于现状(现状=同一文件两套结论,#3219 实测坐实)。A 结构性消灭「在哪跑」这个自由度,AI 无从跑错;B 仍留两个入口,靠守卫兜底。**倾向 A**,但它是跨 17 包的配置面重构、与在飞单大面积撞文件,须单独排一轮空批次执行——这正是需要你定 appetite 的原因。

过渡期已止血:第 33 单(#3378+#3288)只做「错误调用方式响亮失败 + 文档」,不动配置面,与本决策不冲突、先行落地。

维护者裁决（2026-08-06，经 PM 会话 `session_01MN3ao9kJEtD7PNAKwFVp96` 转达）：**A —— 全删 17 个包的本地 vitest.config，统一走根配置**。执行约束：

- 单独排一轮**空批次**执行（跨 17 包配置面重构，与任何在飞单不同批）；
- 同单重定义 `pnpm --filter <pkg> test` 的语义（对根配置传路径过滤），并重估 turbo `test` 任务的 `^build` 依赖；
- 逐包确认没有依赖本地配置的特殊 environment/setup，有则迁进根配置的 projects；
- 30 处整模块 `vi.mock('@object-ui/react', …)` 的脆弱性是独立问题：配置统一后补一条 lint 规则（禁止对 workspace 包整模块 mock / 强制 `importOriginal`），单独立单，⛔ 不塞进本单。

摘 `needs-user-decision`，回 `pm:queue`；已在飞的止血单（#3378+#3288，响亮失败+文档）先行落地，与本裁决不冲突。

补一份实测清单,供本单排期时把「重定义包级 `test` 脚本语义」这一项的面算准 —— 来自 #3746(runner 包级入口 4 红)的落地,**不改本单方向,也不请求提前执行**。

## 测到的形状:被劫持的不是 1 个包,是 8 个

#3746 正文推断「runner 的特殊之处只是它目录里有一个 `vite.config.ts` 可被 vitest 误取」。在 `origin/main` @ `6402e253f` 上按谓词扫全仓(`packages`/`apps`/`examples` 里有 `test` 脚本的 39 个包),**有 `vite.config.*`、没有 vitest 配置、脚本是 bare `vitest run`** 的共 8 个:

```
packages/plugin-ai          test: vitest run --passWithNoTests
packages/plugin-chatbot     test: vitest run
packages/plugin-designer    test: vitest run
packages/plugin-editor      test: vitest run
packages/plugin-markdown    test: vitest run
packages/plugin-report      test: vitest run
packages/plugin-tree        test: vitest run
packages/runner             test: vitest run          <- #3746 已修
```

这 8 个的包级入口都**不会**走到本仓的 guard(`scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` 只在仓根 `vitest.config.mts` 顶部被调用),因为 vitest 先把同目录那份 Vite **应用**配置当成自己的配置读了进去 —— 那里面没有 `test` 块,于是没有 DOM 环境、没有 setup。runner 因此拿到 4 个 `ReferenceError: window is not defined`;其余 7 个是否同红取决于各自测试是否碰 DOM,**未逐个实测,不声称**。

对照面(仅供本单核对):17 份包级 vitest 配置里 6 份是继承仓根的(`components`/`core`/`fields`/`plugin-dashboard`/`react`/`types`),它们的包级入口被 guard 明确拒绝(实测 `pnpm --filter @object-ui/react test` → `package-cwd`,报错正文完整);另 11 份是**独立** `defineConfig`(`plugin-calendar`/`plugin-charts`/`plugin-detail`/`plugin-form`/`plugin-gantt`/`plugin-grid`/`plugin-kanban`/`plugin-list`/`plugin-map`/`plugin-timeline`/`plugin-view`),它们同样不加载仓根配置,所以也不在 guard 底下。也就是说本单执行时,「不受 guard 保护的包级入口」是 8 + 11 = 19 个,而不只是配置分叉那 17 个。

## #3746 的落地形状,供本单参考(并非既成事实的扩面)

runner 一条脚本改成本单裁决 A 已经定下的那种语义 —— 对仓根配置传路径过滤:

```diff
-    "test": "vitest run"
+    "test": "vitest run --root ../.. packages/runner/"
```

即 AGENTS.md §怎么跑测试 与 guard 报错正文都指定的写法。效果:包级入口 3 文件 / 13 用例全绿,与仓根入口**同一份配置**、计数一致;`vitest list --filesOnly` 显示 runner 的 3 个文件各自只在一个 project 注册(`[unit]` x2、`[dom]` x1),仓根 projects 机制不受影响;`--root` 指回仓根后 guard 仍在链路上(`--` 转发照样被拒)。**没有新增第 18 份包级 vitest 配置** —— 本单要删的东西没有变多。

细节:`--passWithNoTests`(plugin-ai)在改造后要复核还需不需要 —— 仓根配置的 `passWithNoTests` 是由命令行是否点名文件派生的(`passWithNoTests: !cliHasTestFilters(process.argv)`),而改造后的脚本恰恰点名了路径,于是零匹配会变成非零退出。这对本单是**好事**(写错的过滤面不再绿着退出),但会让「本来就没有测试文件」的包在改造当天翻红,排期时值当留一手。

⛔ 本评论只记录测量与一次单包落地,不申请提前执行本单;这 7 个包按裁决留给本单的空批次。PR:#3869。

Measured datapoint for this card, found while working objectui#3339 (plugin-detail test hygiene). Attaching here rather than filing a twin — the fix falls inside this card's completion scope, and it sharpens option B in particular.

**The standalone package configs silently bypass `assertCanonicalVitestInvocation`, and the guard's own docstring says they cannot.**

`scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` states its coverage claim explicitly:

> Called from the top of `vitest.config.mts`, so it covers EVERY entry point into this repo's Vitest ... (Every per-package `vitest.config.ts` re-exports the root config, and a package without one — e.g. `packages/app-shell` — resolves upward to it, so no package-level path skips this file.)

That parenthetical is false today. Classifying every per-package config by whether it reaches the root one:

- **re-exports the root config (8):** `apps/console`, `examples/schema-catalog`, `components`, `core`, `fields`, `plugin-dashboard`, `react`, `types`
- **standalone, guard never runs (11):** `plugin-calendar`, `plugin-charts`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-gantt`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-map`, `plugin-timeline`, `plugin-view`

Run against `origin/main` @ `c29ceffb8`, the two halves behave in opposite ways for the very invocation the guard exists to refuse (Trap 1, package-cwd):

```
# core — RE-EXPORTS: guard fires, run refused (correct)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/core exec vitest run
=> vitest 调用被拒绝:从包目录跑 vitest 会静默跑错测试集 (objectui#3378)

# plugin-detail — STANDALONE: guard never loads, run proceeds
pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail exec vitest run src/__tests__/detailColumns.test.ts
=> RUN v4.1.10 /home/user/objectui-issue-3339/packages/plugin-detail
=> Test Files  1 passed (1)   Tests  6 passed (6)
```

Why this matters for the direction question this card asks:

1. It is a **third** independent variable on top of the two already documented above (alias to src vs dist, and whether setupFiles pre-warmed the consumer module): for 11 of the 17 packages the false-green *protection* is also absent, so the divergence these configs create is exactly the divergence nothing is watching.
2. Concretely for `plugin-detail`: its standalone config points at `packages/plugin-detail/vitest.setup.ts`, which is only `import '@testing-library/jest-dom'` — no `vitest.setup.base` polyfills and **no RTL `cleanup()` afterEach**. Under the root config the same files get `vitest.setup.dom-light.tsx`. So that setup file is dead under the canonical invocation while remaining live under the bypassing one.
3. It gives option B a concrete acceptance test: whatever mechanical anti-drift check B needs, "every per-package config reaches `assertCanonicalVitestInvocation`" is a one-line assertion that would have caught all 11 — and the guard's docstring should stop asserting a property nothing enforces.

No opinion offered on A vs B here; this is only evidence for the maintainer's direction call, and I changed none of it in objectui#3339 (that PR is test-only and touches two `plugin-detail` test files).

Measurement from #5406 / PR #5412, recorded here rather than as a duplicate card — this card owns the divergence question, #5406 only owned the guard's coverage of it.

**The count in the title is stale.** Measured on `origin/main` @ fd227eae1, there are **18** non-root vitest configs (19 files counting the root `vitest.config.mts`), not 17 — the extra two are outside `packages/`: `apps/console/vitest.config.ts` and `examples/schema-catalog/vitest.config.ts`.

Split by whether the config actually diverges:

- **7 lead back to the root config** and inherit its aliases, project split and setup files, so there is little to decide about them: `packages/core`, `react`, `types` re-export it verbatim (two lines each); `components`, `fields`, `plugin-dashboard`, `apps/console` merge a local vite config into it; `examples/schema-catalog` strips only the `projects` key, with a comment explaining why.
- **11 are standalone and genuinely divergent**: `plugin-calendar`, `-charts`, `-detail`, `-form`, `-gantt`, `-grid`, `-kanban`, `-list`, `-map`, `-timeline`, `-view`. Each is a self-contained `defineConfig` declaring `happy-dom` + `globals: true` + `setupFiles: ['./vitest.setup.ts']`, and **no `resolve.alias` table at all** — where the root config maps roughly 40 `@object-ui/*` specifiers at a sibling package's `src/`. Each package's `vitest.setup.ts` is a single line, `import '@testing-library/jest-dom'`. The 11 are byte-identical apart from an unused `import path from 'path'` present in 7 of them (a standing eslint warning on `main`).

So the divergence is not per-package tuning that someone chose — it is one pre-monorepo template copied eleven times, and the thing it diverges on is the alias table, i.e. whether `@object-ui/core` resolves to a sibling's `src/` (what CI does) or through `node_modules` (what these do). Measured: under one of these configs a test importing `@object-ui/core` fails with `Failed to resolve import "@object-ui/core"` unless the dependency happens to be built.

**What PR #5412 changes about this card's premise, and what it does not.** It makes every one of the 11 call the invocation guard, so a package-cwd run in them is now refused. It changes none of their test semantics. The consequence for this card is that **those 11 configs are now unreachable by any accepted invocation**: CI runs `pnpm test` from the repo root, the root config's `projects` array names only `apps/console`, and every package-cwd run is refused. They are now inert configuration that still reads as live — which sharpens the question this card asks (delete them, or make them re-export the root config like their six siblings) rather than answering it.

No new card filed; this belongs here.

## State: `pm:queue` → **`pm:on-hold`**, and the title's count is stale by a wider margin than the last note recorded

By the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat (#5748), PM session `session_019b5UBNMtTzKbVtZZGvFuxe`. ⛔ **Nothing about the direction changes** — option **A** stands, ruled by the maintainer 2026-08-06 and reaffirmed by the delegated ruling of 2026-08-10.

### Why the label moves

The 2026-08-10 ruling states the scheduling constraint in as many words:

> **Scheduling: this stays OUT of the rolling queue.** … a 17-package config-face refactor collides with everything in flight and runs as a **DEDICATED batch in a quiet window** (board drained or near-drained), single dev, **no parallel dispatches into `packages/*` during its run**.

`pm:queue` means "dispatchable, waiting for a slot", and this card is not that — it is dispatchable only when the *board* is in a particular state. Leaving it queued invites exactly the mistake the ruling forbids: a seat topping up a batch reaches for it, and now a 19-package config-face refactor is running beside five other dispatches into `packages/*`. That very nearly happened here — I picked this card up this round while looking for batch fill, and stopped at the mandatory comment re-read. `pm:on-hold` puts the constraint where the next seat sees it before it starts, not three commands in.

⚠️ The condition is unmet right now and not close: **six dispatches in flight**, several of them into `packages/*`.

### What the executing dev will need to re-derive — the counts have moved twice

The title says 17. The last recorded correction (2026-08-20, from #5406 / PR #5412) says **18 non-root configs**, split **7 that lead back to the root config** and **11 genuinely standalone**. Beyond that, three separate measurements on this card have each widened the scope from a different direction, and they do not compose into one number:

| measurement | population | note |
|---|---|---|
| the original card | 17 packages with `vitest.config.*` | `ls packages/*/vitest.config.*` |
| #3746 (2026-08-08) | **19** package entries unprotected by the invocation guard | 8 with a `vite.config.*` and no vitest config, plus the 11 standalone |
| #5406 / PR #5412 (2026-08-20) | **18** non-root configs, 7 inheriting + 11 standalone | adds `apps/console` and `examples/schema-catalog`, which are outside `packages/` |

⭐ And PR #5412 changed the card's premise in a way that makes the work **easier**, not harder: it made all 11 standalone configs call the invocation guard, so a package-cwd run in them is now refused. Combined with CI running `pnpm test` from the root and the root config's `projects` array naming only `apps/console`, **those 11 configs are now unreachable by any accepted invocation.** They are inert configuration that still reads as live. Deleting inert files is a far smaller blast radius than deleting live ones — which is worth knowing before the appetite for the quiet window is set.

⛔ Do not carry any of the numbers above into the execution order. Every one of them is a snapshot, three of them disagree, and the card's own history is that each re-measurement found the population wider than the last. Re-derive at claim time.

### Also still binding from the ruling

- The 30 whole-module `vi.mock('@object-ui/react', …)` call sites are a **separate** problem with its own card (a lint rule forbidding whole-module mocks of workspace packages / requiring `importOriginal`). ⛔ Not to be folded in here.
- The same card redefines `pnpm --filter PKG test` to pass a path filter to the root config, and re-estimates turbo's `test` / `^build` dependency. PR #3869 landed that shape for `packages/runner` as a single-package precedent, and added **no** new package-level vitest config — so the set to delete has not grown by that route.
- ⚠️ `--passWithNoTests` needs a re-check on the day: the root config derives `passWithNoTests` from whether the command line names files, and the converted scripts do name paths — so a package that genuinely has no test files flips red on conversion day. Good for the gate, surprising if unplanned.

**Unblocks when:** the board is drained or near-drained, with a slot for a single dev and no concurrent `packages/*` dispatches.

## `Restart-when:` added to the body — the hold was legitimate but had no machine-readable exit, so nothing could ever wake it

`domain:devx` execution seat (session `session_019aCUUSwWefnbCJ4Xk1vqQW`, R42). ⛔ **The direction is untouched**: option **A** stands, ruled by the maintainer 2026-08-06 and reaffirmed by the delegated ruling of 2026-08-10. ⛔ No label change, no assignee, not dispatched.

### What was wrong, and it was not the hold itself

The hold is substantively correct — the decision *was* made, and the answer is "not now, in a quiet window". That is exactly what `pm:on-hold` means. What was missing is the **exit**: the state model admits a hold only when it carries a machine-readable `Restart-when:` line, and this card's restart condition existed **only as prose inside a comment**:

> **Scheduling: this stays OUT of the rolling queue.** … runs as a **DEDICATED batch in a quiet window** (board drained or near-drained), single dev, **no other work in flight**.

A condition written that way cannot be evaluated by anything but a person who happens to read the comment thread. So this card could sit held forever *even on the day its condition came true* — which is not a hypothetical: see below.

The line now in the body restates that ruling verbatim in intent and adds the executable check. It invents nothing.

### ⚠️ The condition is very nearly met right now

Measured on this lane at 2026-09-03T07:5xZ:

| clause of the ruled condition | reading |
|:--|:--|
| board drained or near-drained | **yes** — `domain:devx` @ objectui has **no dispatchable card** other than #5174. #4853, #6653 and #5250 are all `pm:retriage`; #6342 is another identity's claim |
| no other work in flight | **not yet** — #5174 is `pm:dispatched` with batches 10 and 11 running |

⇒ The moment those two batches land and nothing else is dispatched, this card's `Restart-when:` evaluates **true**, and it becomes the natural next dedicated batch — which is precisely what the 2026-08-10 ruling reserved a quiet window for. ⛔ Not dispatching it now: "single dev, no other work in flight" is part of the ruling, not a detail to round off.

### This card is an instance of #6653, and the most expensive kind

#6653 records that blocked cards in this repo carry no machine-readable dependency line. R42's manual scan measured this lane at **14 of 14** — the mechanical unlock scan here cannot return anything, ever. This card shows the failure at its worst: not a card whose blocker is merely hard to see, but one whose **restart condition was satisfiable and invisible at the same time**, held since 2026-08-25 behind a condition the board has since met.

Recorded on #6653 as well. The remedy applied here — put the ruled condition in the body, in the form the sweep reads — is the same one available to the other thirteen.

- Session: `session_019aCUUSwWefnbCJ4Xk1vqQW` (execution seat, `domain:devx` @ objectui, seat post #5748, R42)
- Branch: `claude/issue-3240-vitest-config-unification`

Tier reasoning stated because this touches gate semantics: the **design is already ruled** (option A), so what remains is implementation plus per-package verification — the ruling-implementation case, not the gate-semantics-design case that would take this to the contract-review tier. ⛔ The dev may not redesign; if it believes A is wrong it stops and reports.
- Clause-②: no
- State: `pm:on-hold` → `pm:dispatched` in one transition. The intermediate `pm:queue` is skipped deliberately — the restart condition and the dispatch are the same act here, and a queue state nobody would observe is a half-state, not a record. The re-verification the state model requires before returning a held card is below.

### The `Restart-when:` fired — evaluated, not assumed

The line added to the body today reads: *no `pm:dispatched` card exists in the `domain:devx` @ objectui lane*. Measured at 2026-09-03T09:4xZ by listing every open `domain:devx` issue:

> **`pm:dispatched` cards: NONE.**

The remaining `pm:queue` cards are #4853 (`pm:retriage`), #5174 (the rolling ledger card the condition explicitly admits under the ruling's "or near-drained"), #6342 (another identity's claim) and #6653. Batches 10 and 11 merged minutes earlier (`c39c825d3`, `c4f541df9`), which is what emptied the in-flight set.
